title: Business Development Executive
company: BPX Electro Mechanical Co Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
As BPX continues to grow, we are looking to strengthen our team and recruit a Business Development Executive to support the ambitious plans at our Leicester branch (LE7 7 NL). We are looking for someone with strong sales experience who possesses the skills needed to identify new business opportunities and lead growth initiatives within the existing portfolio. The ability to build relationships, work in a team, and continually learn will make the difference in this role. If you can bring high energy, initiative, and a technical interest to deliver the best solutions for customers, your career at BPX will fly.

About Us:

For 60 years BPX (part of the RS Group) has built a reputation as the leading independent distributor of factory automation and control components - from computers to connectors, from robots to relays and everything in between. We now employ over 180 people and from our 15 locations throughout the UK & Ireland, we provide a local service to our customers.

Our continued success comes from our passion for technology and commitment to customer service. We are a talented group across our UK and Ireland branch network and work towards our mission for our customers, "help to choose, help to use".

BPX are the strategic partner to market leading brands such as Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, Omron and many more, offering innovative products, solutions and technical support to thousands of customers UK wide.

The main duties will include:

Deliver sales growth through the development of both new and existing businesses within the defined geographical area.

Build trust and develop strong relationships with customers, manufacturers, and colleagues to achieve 'win-win' outcomes for all stakeholders.

Adopt a consultative approach to sales, presenting solutions to customers that deliver value and help solve their industrial control and automation challenges Balance the demands of prospecting for new business, in addition to enhancing relationships and contact points within the existing account portfolio.

Maintain a presence in the BPX branch, staying close to the people and local market.

Support marketing activities such as campaigns and promotions to increase customer awareness of product launches, events, competitions, etc.

Commit to learning, development, and training in both technical and non-technical areas.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

Experience in B2 B sales, ideally with knowledge of the industrial distribution market.

Drive sales growth opportunities through new and existing accounts/partnerships.

Familiar with the market dynamics between manufacturers, distributors, and customers.

Strong relationship builder, communicator, and team player.

Customer-centric, able to identify challenges and present solutions.

Organised and able to prioritise as required.

Committed to build knowledge across industrial control and automation products.

Familiar with CRM systems and able to produce sales reports.

BPX offers great benefits such as:

Minimum of 31 days annual leave including bank holidays (increasing with length of service)

Access to our training and development platform

Friendly and supportive work environment

Dress down Fridays

Access to the Employee Assistance Programme

Recruitment referral bonus

Opportunities for career progression

Cycle 2 Work scheme

Ability to carry forward unused holiday

Option to purchase additional annual leave

Free onsite parking

Emergency loans

BPX remains a financially secure business, offering the chance to work within a happy, friendly company with some wonderful and talented people.

If you like a challenge and believe you are the right person to join our team, please click apply and upload your CV, we look forward to hearing from you!

We reserve the right to close the advert early when a suitable candidate is found.

No Agencies, please

title: Graduate Medical Sales Representative - Dermatology & Allergy
description:
Evolve Selection is exclusively partnering with a leading global pharmaceutical company to deliver an exciting new team build across the UK.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a brand-new team as a Healthcare Partnership Associate, representing an innovative portfolio of products across Dermatology and Allergy. You'll have the opportunity to help shape and grow a developing team, build valuable relationships across primary care and make a real contribution to improving patient outcomes.

Combining scientific engagement, relationship building and commercial ownership, you'll work in partnership with healthcare professionals to identify opportunities, develop your territory and deliver meaningful value across these exciting therapeutic areas.

Whether you're a recent graduate looking to launch your career in the pharmaceutical industry, an entry-level sales professional ready for your next step, or an experienced medical sales professional seeking a new challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Previous pharmaceutical experience is not essential, with training and development available to support those new to the industry.

This is a full-time, permanent position covering the East Midlands region of the UK, with exact territory boundaries to be confirmed. Please note that a full, valid UK driving licence is essential for this role.

What s on offer?
- Highly Competitive starting salary of £35,000, plus exceptional benefits package - including bonus, car allowance, pension, holiday buy back scheme and more!
- Innovative Product Portfolio - Work with leading dermatology and allergy products in a specialist market.
- Collaborative Culture - Thrive in a supportive, people-focused environment.

Ideal Requirements:
- Open to Graduates and Entry-Level Professionals - Previous pharmaceutical experience is not essential. We welcome applications from graduates and early-career professionals with transferable skills, enthusiasm and a desire to build a career in pharmaceutical sales.
- A Passion for Healthcare and Learning - A degree in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline is desirable, alongside a genuine interest in healthcare and a willingness to develop strong clinical and product knowledge. We welcome applications from both experienced professionals and graduates with transferable skills who are keen to build a career in pharmaceutical sales.
- Strong Relationship-Building and Communication Skills - The ability to build credible, lasting relationships with healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders. You will be confident communicating, influencing and adapting your approach to meet different customer needs.
- Commercial Awareness and a Drive to Succeed - A proactive, results-focused mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, work towards objectives and contribute to business growth. Previous experience in a target-driven commercial or healthcare environment would be advantageous.
- Self-Motivation and Effective Territory Management - The confidence and initiative to work independently, manage your time effectively and take ownership of a geographical territory. You will be organised, adaptable and comfortable planning your activities to maximise opportunities.
- A Commitment to Professional Excellence - A commitment to working ethically and responsibly within the pharmaceutical industry. An understanding of the ABPI Code, previous pharmaceutical sales experience and an ABPI qualification would be advantageous, although support and development will be available for candidates new to the industry.

Role Responsibilities:
- Build Meaningful Healthcare Partnerships - Develop trusted, long-term relationships with GPs, practice-based clinicians, community pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, becoming a valued partner and a recognised source of clinical and product expertise within your territory.
- Drive Territory Growth and Commercial Success - Take ownership of your territory, identifying new opportunities, developing strategic business plans and using sales data and market insights to maximise growth, achieve sales targets and deliver outstanding commercial results.
- Deliver Engaging, Clinically Relevant Customer Conversations - Bring clinical evidence to life through high-quality, tailored discussions that demonstrate the benefits, appropriate use and value of specialist products, supporting healthcare professionals to make informed decisions that benefit patients.
- Shape Local Healthcare Opportunities Through Collaboration - Work closely with internal colleagues and cross-functional teams to develop effective engagement strategies, strengthen local partnerships and align product offerings with NHS priorities and evolving patient needs, including opportunities within Pharmacy First.
- Champion Professional Excellence and Patient Outcomes - Operate with integrity and professionalism, maintaining excellent clinical and product knowledge while ensuring all activities meet ABPI and regulatory standards. Keep patients at the heart of every interaction and ensure responsible use of resources.

Recruitment Process:

2 stage interview and assessment process

Interview with a hiring manager who is a passionate and experienced leader, values your ideas, mentors your growth, and is committed to helping you succeed in this role.

Excited to learn more? Click apply or reach out to our recruitment team for full details!

Application Process:

Evolve Selection acts as a recruitment partner on behalf of our clients. All applications are reviewed by our specialist consultants and assessed against the specific requirements of the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted for an initial discussion before being introduced to the hiring client.

We appreciate every application; however, due to application volumes, we may not be able to respond to all candidates individually. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days, please consider your application unsuccessful for this particular role, however we may contact you regarding future opportunities that match your experience in line with our privacy policy.

Evolve is a leading recruitment and outsourcing organisation, operating within the Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Medical Device and Life Science sectors.

Equal opportunities are important to us. We believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to our success as a company, We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, ethnicity, belief, age, family or parental status, and any other characteristic.

title: Sales Agent (Utility Consultant)
description:
Sales Agent / Utility Consultant - Wanted!

Leicester Based Salary: £30,000 + 10% Commission

Permanent, Full-Time

Are you an experienced Sales Agent / Utility Consultant?

Regional Recruitment are recruiting for Sales Agent (Utility Consultant), you will play a key role in generating new business, driving growth in sales and building long lasting relationships with customers and key accounts. If you have a passion for lead generation, networking and consultative sales then this role is for you!

What's on Offer:
- Competitive salary plus commission
- 22 days annual leave plus bank holidays (will grow 1 day per year of service until 25)
- Monday to Friday (8 00) with 1:15 in total breaks time
- Opportunity to work with an established and successful business
- Fast paced and varied working environment
- Opportunity to develop and progress your sales career

Qualifications

Essential:
- Previous experience in B2 B sales, telesales, business development or a similar sales-focused role
- Ability to conduct at least 100 cold calls per day
- Confident communicator with strong telephone and relationship-building skills
- Proven ability to generate new business and identify sales opportunities
- Target-driven and motivated by achieving and exceeding sales targets
- Ability to build rapport and develop strong relationships with prospective clients
- Proactive and resilient approach to sales
- Excellent on-call etiquette
- Good Attendance
- Punctuality

Desirable:
- Experience as utility sales agent is desirable but not essential
- Experience selling marketing, sales or professional services
- Previous experience working within a high-volume outbound sales environment

Roles & Responsibilities
- Proactively identify and generate new B2 B sales opportunities through outbound calling
- Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients
- Understand client requirements and effectively communicate the benefits of the company's marketing and sales services
- Manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing the deal
- Follow up on leads and opportunities to maximise conversion rates
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activity and pipeline opportunities
- Consistently work towards and achieve individual sales targets and KPIs
- Identify opportunities to develop existing client relationships and generate additional business

Requirements

As Sales Agent (Utility Consultant), you will also be expected to:
- Proactive, driven individual who thrives in fast paced environments
- Be confident, driven and commercially minded
- Thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven sales environment
- Be comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and speaking with decision-makers
- Have a resilient and positive attitude, with the ability to handle objections and turn them into opportunities
- Be motivated by commission and the opportunity to earn alongside your basic salary

About Regional Recruitment

This position is being advertised by Regional Recruitment Ltd, an award-winning independent recruitment agency established in 2008. We specialise in permanent, temporary, and contract opportunities across the Commercial, Construction, Industrial, Technology, and Engineering sectors.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Sales Coordinator - Part Time

Fancy a part-time role where no two days look the same, hours built around you, and your work helping to win new business? One hire really does make a difference at a business this size.

Salary: £28,000 -£32,000

Permanent

Hinckley

22.5 Hours Per Week

About the role

JML Contractors Ltd is a growing mechanical and electrical contractor, delivering projects and maintenance work across the UK. Services span electrical installations, air conditioning, EV charging infrastructure and renewable energy solutions, and this role sits at the centre of the business's growth.

You'll work closely with the management team to identify new opportunities, look after existing clients, and keep quotes and tenders on track from first enquiry through to award. Your work feeds directly into the reports management use to track pipeline and conversion.

What's in it for you
- Hours built around you, with flexibility on days and start and finish times
- A varied role spanning business development, client relationships and tender management
- Genuine career progression as JML continues to grow
- A small, close-knit team where your work is noticed

What you'll do

You'll:
- Identify and research new business opportunities and prospective clients
- Contact prospective clients to introduce JML's services and build relationships
- Maintain regular contact with existing clients, including after-sales follow-up calls
- Gather customer feedback and promote JML's wider range of services
- Maintain the company's lead, quote and tender register
- Track quotations and tenders from enquiry through to award, following up with customers

What you'll need (essential)
- Proven experience in business development, sales support, account management, customer service or tender administration
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook
- Excellent communication skills with both customers and internal colleagues
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to push tenders through the process

Nice to have
- Experience within construction, engineering, M&E, electrical, mechanical or facilities management
- Experience managing quotations, tenders or a sales pipeline
- Familiarity with CRM systems

Working arrangements

hours a week, worked across days that suit you, with the exact pattern agreed at interview. Based on-site at JML's Hinckley office.

How to apply

If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to hear from you. Click apply and send over your CV.

title: Customer Service & Sales Coordinator
description:
Sales Coordinator
Up to 30,000
Loughborough, Onsite

We're looking for a proactive and organised Sales Coordinator to join a busy team. This is a varied role combining customer service, administration and internal sales, ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, spotting opportunities to up-sell and contributing to business growth.

The Role
- Act as the first point of contact for customer enquiries, providing a professional and responsive service.
- Process customer orders, prepare quotations and provide accurate pricing information.
- Proactively identify opportunities to up-sell products and generate additional sales.
- Build strong customer relationships, confidently engaging with customers to promote products and encourage repeat business.
- Handle delivery, invoice and customer queries, resolving issues efficiently.
- Maintain accurate customer records and update internal systems.
- Liaise with internal teams and external contacts to ensure orders are processed and delivered smoothly.
- Support the coordination of deliveries and work with suppliers to agree competitive rates where required.

About You
- Previous experience in customer service, administration and/or internal sales.
- Confident communicating with customers and comfortable taking a proactive approach to sales.
- Able to identify up-selling opportunities and turn customer enquiries into sales.
- Strong organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confident using IT systems and CRM platforms.
- A positive, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Experience within manufacturing, construction or a related industry would be advantageous.

If you're a customer-focused individual who enjoys a mix of administration, relationship building and sales, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Sales Account Manager
(Education)
£25,000 - £30,000 Commission
Full time, Permanent
Leicester, Hybrid (3 days in office)

Are you currently working in education, perhaps in sales, business support or operations? Would you like to build a career in sales without cold calling, while increasing your earning potential through uncapped commission?

We are working with an established software business with a strong presence in the education sector. Following continued growth, they are looking for someone with an education background to join their successful team.

You will be confident building relationships, asking the right questions and moving conversations forward. You might already work in education sales, or have gained experience discussing requirements, presenting solutions or supporting buying decisions as part of a wider role.

Above all, you will understand how schools and trusts operate, recognise that their needs differ and enjoy helping them find a solution that works for them.

The role
- Following up on inbound enquiries by phone and email
- Building rapport with school and trust contacts to understand their needs
- Identifying decision makers, purchasing processes and potential barriers
- Discussing budgets, priorities, existing contracts and renewal dates
- Booking qualified meetings and providing clear handover notes to senior Sales colleagues
- Nurturing prospects who are interested but aren t ready to move forward
- Generating new opportunities through proactive calls, emails and follow-up
- Maintaining clear, accurate records in the CRM

The candidate
- Experience in the education sector, either within a school or trust, or through a business selling to this sector
- Great understanding of school priorities, budget requirements and decision-making
- Proactive approach and driven mindset to keep conversations moving
- Strong organisation skills and consistent follow-through
- Motivated to work towards targets and develop a career in software sales

In return
- £25,000 - £30,000 per annum commission
- Hybrid working, including 2 days from home
- The opportunity to join an established software business
- Further development opportunities for a career in EdTech Sales

Are you ready for your next step in EdTech Sales? Click Apply today!
